snippet.title: Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes｜Console Trailer
snippet.description:
Keep Talking and Nobody Explodes is now on consoles! 

Nintendo Switch™: http://bit.ly/KeepTalkingSwitch
Xbox One (Aug 17): https://bit.ly/KeepTalkingXboxOne
PS4: https://bit.ly/KeepTalkingPS4

Find yourself alone in a room with a bomb. Your friends have the manual to defuse it, but they can’t see the bomb, so you're going to have to talk it out – fast!

This local co-op game requires two or more players. View the Bomb Defusal Manual at:  http://www.bombmanual.com


Visit our website: http://www.keeptalkinggame.com
Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/KeepTalkingGame
Follow us on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/KeepTalkingGame/

© 2018 Steel Crate Games, Inc. All rights reserved.
